title: Smooth step profile on ℝ: 1 on (−∞, 1/2], 0 on [1, ∞), values in [0, 1], 3-Lipschitz
statement: There is a C^infinity function φ : R → R such that (i) 0 <= φ(t) <= 1 for every t; (ii) φ(t) = 1 for every t <= 1/2; (iii) φ(t) = 0 for every t >= 1; (iv) φ is 3-Lipschitz, i.e. |φ(s) − φ(t)| <= 3|s − t| for all s, t ∈ R.
lean_statement: ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ φ t ∧ φ t ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ t, t ≤ 1 / 2 → φ t = 1) ∧ (∀ t, 1 ≤ t → φ t = 0) ∧ LipschitzWith 3 φ
